title: Profile avatar removal UI and immediate fallback rendering

requirements.summary: Add a confirmed “Remove Photo” action on the Profile page that sets profileImage to null via the existing update flow, immediately falling back to the default avatar and clearing any local preview/file state.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user has an existing profile photo, the Profile page shows a visible action to remove it while in edit mode (or otherwise clearly accessible).
When the user confirms removal, the frontend calls the existing profile update flow with `profileImage = null` and keeps the current bio unchanged unless the user edits it.
After successful removal, the Profile page no longer renders an `AvatarImage` for the user and shows the fallback initial instead.
After a normal page reload and/or logout + login, the profile photo remains removed (still fallback initial).
Any temporary local preview URL and selected file state are cleared when removal succeeds or when the user cancels editing.

file_operations.description: Implement a remove-avatar flow in edit mode: add a clearly visible "Remove Photo" button when a profile image exists (or a new preview is selected), show a confirmation dialog, and on confirm call the existing profile update mutation with profileImage = null while preserving the current bio value. On success, immediately clear selectedFile and any previewUrl (revoking the object URL), exit edit mode as appropriate, and ensure the AvatarImage is not rendered so the AvatarFallback (initial) shows. Also ensure cancel editing clears preview/file state. Use existing shadcn-ui primitives already in the file (e.g., Button, Dialog, Avatar); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure the authenticated Header avatar immediately reflects profile photo removal by rendering the fallback when profileImage is null and reliably re-rendering after currentUserProfile invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: After removing the profile photo, the Header avatar no longer shows the old image and instead shows the fallback avatar without requiring a hard refresh.
The Header continues to display the profile image when `profileImage` is present, unchanged from current behavior.

file_operations.description: Harden Header avatar rendering against stale images: derive avatarSrc only when profile.profileImage is present, and ensure AvatarImage unmounts/reloads when avatarSrc changes (e.g., by keying AvatarImage/Avatar on avatarSrc). Confirm it correctly falls back to AvatarFallback when avatarSrc is empty after React Query invalidates ['currentUserProfile']. Uses existing shadcn-ui Avatar/DropdownMenu components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
